name: RuView
description: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel of video.
one_liner: Turns the ordinary WiFi signal already in your home into a motion and health sensor — it can tell if someone fell, track their breathing and heart rate, and sense where people are in a room, all without a single camera.
buyer: An adult child caring for an aging parent who wants fall detection and vital-sign monitoring without installing cameras in mom's house.
business_use_cases: A home-care company offers a camera-free fall-detection and vitals-monitoring add-on for elderly clients living alone.
A smart-home security installer sells presence detection as a privacy-friendly alternative to camera-based occupancy sensing.
A home healthcare provider monitors a recovering patient's breathing and movement remotely between nurse visits.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a hardware kit (router + RuView) bundled with a monthly family-monitoring subscription and alerts.
License the sensing tech to smart-home platform makers as a privacy-first occupancy feature.

steal_this: Build a 'camera-free fall detection for grandma' starter kit this weekend using a cheap router and RuView, and sell it with a $15/month family-alert subscription.
